summary: Evans introduced a House resolution in June 2025 designating "Free Palestine" an official antisemitic slogan, and in October 2026 posted that he stands "with Israel and Colorado's Jewish community." His campaign claims a Republican Jewish Coalition endorsement, and Vote for Peace lists him as opposed in the general. His legislative move to suppress pro-Palestinian speech and his public alignment with Israel mark a record of shielding Israel over Palestinian justice.
